welcome.title: Welcome to Alberta Expeditions
welcome.description: Alberta Expeditions is part of Alberta Tomorrow's educational platform. Each expedition is a short, hands-on journey into a different part of Alberta's wildlife, landscapes, geology, or history.
structure: Home shows every expedition as a card with its own mountain.
Start an expedition to add its page to your journal.
Complete checkpoints to record field notes and plant a flag on the summit.

expeditions.title: Choose your expedition
expeditions.description: From swift foxes on the shortgrass prairie to dinosaur country in the badlands and the history that shaped our province, every card is a new route across Alberta.

journal.title: Your expedition journal
journal.description: Pick an expedition card to begin. Every expedition you start gets its own page in your journal, filled with field notes about what you discover.

finish.title: You're ready to explore!
finish.description: Good luck out there, and have fun discovering Alberta.

exploreMap.title: Explore the Alberta map
exploreMap.description: This is the map. Select a point of interest to learn about places across Alberta.

viewToggle.title: Switch between 2D and 3D
viewToggle.description: Use this button to switch between the flat map and a raised 3D terrain view. You can change views any time.

flyPlane.title: Take off with Fly Plane
flyPlane.description: Choose Fly Plane or press P to explore Alberta from above. During flight, P pauses or resumes the plane. Your first flight includes a short guide to choosing destinations and using the flight controls.

explore.title: Explore Alberta
explore.description: Use the point-of-interest selector along the bottom to fly toward a place. Enter a blue cylinder for a base-map place or a gray cylinder for an expedition place to pause and open its information. Completed expedition cylinders are green. Closing the information resumes flight. Continue to see the flight controls.

controls.title: Your flight controls
controls.description: The flight controls are open beside this tip. Take a look, then continue to tuck them away. You can reopen them any time with the button on the left.

player.title: Your media player
player.description: Playback is paused during this tour and resumes when you finish or skip. Use the side buttons to open or collapse the player, pause playback, or close it. The rest of the page is blurred so you can focus on these controls.

open.title: Open the player
open.description: Select the music-note button to open the full player. Try it now, or skip the tour.

controls.title: Keep control of your media
controls.description: Pause or adjust playback here. Collapse the player to keep listening as you explore, close it to stop, or queue media from any expedition to play next.
